relationships.subject: IL-33
relationships.evidence_quote: In vivo, we demonstrated that IL-33 significantly exacerbated endometriosis and induced hyperalgesia in mice.

relationships.subject: IL-33
relationships.evidence_quote: By interacting with the ST2 receptor in macrophages, IL-33 enhanced the release of tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α) and Interleukin 1β (IL-1β).

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Ultimately, macrophage-derived TNF-α increased TRPV1 protein level in DRG neuronal cells through the TNFR1/p38 MAPK signaling pathway.

key_findings: IL-33 exacerbates endometriosis and hyperalgesia in mice via ST2 on macrophages.
Macrophage-derived TNF-alpha raises TRPV1 in DRG neurons through TNFR1/p38 MAPK.
